title: Digest delivery ledger
description: reports/digest/deliveries.json, written by bin/digest-deliver.mjs: one row per digest and destination, rewritten atomically after each attempt so a pair already delivered is not posted again. A destination is named by its kind and a hash of its URL; the URL itself is a credential and never appears, and target carries only its scheme and host.

destination.description: The kind and the first 16 hex characters of the sha256 of the URL.

target.description: scheme://host/… of the URL, or '(unparseable URL)'.

status.description: The HTTP status; null when no response arrived or the URL was refused before sending.

reason.description: Why the attempt failed, with the URL scrubbed; null when delivered.

at.description: When this attempt ended, ISO 8601 (CW_NOW honoured).
